title: Fasoulada
subtitle: Greek white bean soup with olive oil and vegetables
excerpt: Greece's national soup: cannellini beans simmered with celery, carrot, onion and a generous pour of olive oil. Simple, filling and deeply comforting. The olive oil goes in at the end for maximum flavour.
sourceNotes: Fasoulada is considered the national dish of Greece. The olive oil finish is the defining technique of the Greek ladera tradition.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze cooled soup for up to 3 months. Add an extra splash of water when reheating as the beans absorb liquid.
recipe.batchNotes: Scales up easily. Cook in a large stockpot and the method stays the same.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: The soup thickens as it sits. Loosen with a little warm water before reheating.

content.text: Fasoulada is a white bean soup that relies on good olive oil for its richness. The oil goes in twice: a little to soften the vegetables, and a generous pour at the very end. Don't skip that second addition.
Warm 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the carrot, celery and garlic. Stir and cook for 3 more minutes.
Add the tinned tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the drained beans and the water. Bring to the boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Use the back of a spoon to mash about a quarter of the beans against the side of the pan. This thickens the soup without blending.
Remove from the heat. Stir in the remaining olive oil. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve with celery leaves scattered on top.

items.cause: Not enough beans were mashed or too much water was added.
items.fix: Mash more beans and simmer for a further 10 minutes with the lid off.

items.symptom: The soup tastes oily but flat.
items.cause: The olive oil was added too early and cooked off.
items.fix: Always add the main portion of olive oil off the heat at the very end. The raw oil gives the soup its character.

items.cause: The carrot pieces were cut too thick.
items.fix: Slice carrots no thicker than 5 mm. Continue simmering until tender.
